independent_case.title: Changed independent case
independent_case.task: A science assistant may use only these notes: evaporation is liquid becoming vapour; condensation is vapour becoming liquid. Specify behavior for “Define evaporation”, “Explain it”, and “What is tomorrow’s weather?”.
independent_case.answer: Answer the definition using the supplied note and identify its source. Clarify the referent of “it”. Weather is absent from these notes: say the evidence is unavailable rather than inventing a forecast. Require support for every factual claim.

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
A complete capstone plan is not evidence that the implementation meets it; evaluate after building.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.
